statement:
The recorded value of 1,450 dollars matches the rent amount, but directing it to a fixed-term savings account instead of the rent destination would prevent Nora from paying her rent today.
OK. I've made the transfer of 1,450 dollars to rent.
judge_text:
WRONG
It names the specific problem: "directing it to a fixed-term savings account instead of the rent destination would prevent Nora from paying her rent today," and redirects the payment to rent.
